description: This file serves as a header to prevent circular dependencies between CUDAFunctions.h and CUDAExceptions.h, and declares utility functions related to CUDA error handling and synchronization in the c10::cuda namespace.

methods.name: get_cuda_error_help
methods.description: Returns a string containing help information for a CUDA error.

methods.name: get_cuda_check_suffix
methods.description: Returns a suffix used in CUDA error checking messages.

methods.name: getFreeMutex
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a mutex used for thread safety in CUDA-related operations.
